about_the_game: Buddies in a ball is a co-op adventure game that thrusts you and another buddy into a steel metal ball. The players will need to roll the ball through obstacles, working together, in order to complete levels. The players can claim victory if they beat all of the levels, but the jeering fans and taunting announcers will make the journey a little more perilous every step of the way.
